description: Battaglia B12 (pressure) / B16 (gas density) laws refitted to FLAMINGO L1_m9 HYDRO_FIDUCIAL SOAP-HBT aperture integrals (Test K)

conventions.mass: M200c in Msun (no h); pivot 1e14 Msun; A * (M200c/1e14)^alpha_m * (1+z)^alpha_z
conventions.B12: P_e/P200 = 0.5176 * P0 * (x/x_c)^gamma * (1+(x/x_c)^alpha)^(-beta); P200 = G M200c 200 rho_c(z) f_b / (2 R200c); XGPaint Battaglia16ThermalSZProfile(P0_amp, P0_alpha_m, P0_alpha_z, x_c_amp, ..., beta_amp, ...) takes these numbers directly
conventions.B16: rho_gas/(f_b rho_c(z)) = rho0 * (x/x_c)^gamma * (1+(x/x_c)^alpha)^(-(beta+gamma)/alpha); XGPaint BattagliaTauProfile[Physical](P0_amp=rho0 law, ...) paints n_e = 0.9 rho_gas / mu_e (mu_e = (m_e + 2 m_p/(1+X)) with X = 0.76); see 'electron_factors' for the particle-measured n_e / (rho_gas/mu_e)
conventions.brk_amp: amplitude law times (M200c/M_b)^alpha_break for M200c < M_b (XGPaint BreakModel: alpha_break, M_break = M_b)
conventions.brk_all: ln Q = ln Q_b + (alpha_m_low if M < M_b else alpha_m_high) ln(M/M_b) + alpha_z ln(1+z); Q_b = value at M_b and z = 0
conventions.data: SOAP-HBT inclusive SO and physical-kpc sphere integrals, central haloes M200c >= 10^12.7, 0.2-dex cells at 71 outputs
conventions.fit_status: added locally by k_params_status.py from results/k7_fit_audit.json (status codes: scipy least_squares; 0 = stopped at max_nfev, 1-4 = converged); all other fields are the maas output

electron_factors.definition: r = [M_gas / mu_e(X = 0.76, fully ionised)] / N_e(particles), per halo at z = 0 (study haloes, SOAP vs particle pass at the same radius); median and 16-84%
electron_factors.use: electrons = (gas-density law / mu_e) / r; in XGPaint's BattagliaTauProfile (n_e = 0.9 rho_gas / mu_e) paint the refitted gas law with P0_amp multiplied by 1 / (0.9 r)
